title.zh: 币安推出 bStocks 代币化股票产品并扩展交易对
title.en: Binance launches bStocks tokenized equities and expands trading pairs

current_state.zh: 币安宣布，其代币化股票产品 bStocks 上线约四个月后管理资产规模已突破 10 亿美元，累计交易量超过 400 亿美元，约 100 种资产的日交易量超过 3 亿美元，标的股票与代币之间的 1:1 兑换金额超过 60 亿美元。
current_state.en: Binance announced that its tokenized equities product bStocks has surpassed $1 billion in AUM about four months after launch, with over $40 billion in cumulative trading volume, $300 million-plus daily volume across roughly 100 assets, and more than $6 billion in 1:1 conversions between underlying equities and tokens.

updates.title_zh: 币安现允许用户将股票转换为链上代币
updates.title_en: Binance now lets users turn stocks into on-chain tokens
updates.what_changed_zh:
据 Crypto News 报道，币安推出了一项新功能，允许用户将股票转换为链上代币。此举将币安的现实世界资产（RWA）代币化业务扩展至股票领域。

币安是按交易量计全球最大的加密货币交易所，将股票纳入其现实世界资产代币化产品线，意味着链上资产敞口通过现有主流交易平台延伸至新的资产类别。
updates.what_changed_en: Binance has introduced a feature allowing users to convert stocks into on-chain tokens, expanding its tokenized real-world asset offerings to equities.
updates.current_state_zh:

updates.detailed_summary_zh: Binance has introduced a feature allowing users to convert stocks into on-chain tokens, expanding its tokenized real-world asset offerings to equities.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Binance has introduced a feature allowing users to convert stocks into on-chain tokens, expanding its tokenized real-world asset offerings to equities.
updates.background_zh: 据 Chainlink 的科普解释，代币化股票是基于区块链的代币，代表上市公司的股份，并设计为追踪标的股票的价格。其他平台也已进入这一领域：Kraken 通过其 xStocks 产品提供代币化股票和 ETF，Robinhood Chain 则在链上追踪代币化股票。
updates.background_en: Tokenized stocks are blockchain-based tokens that represent shares of publicly traded companies and are designed to mirror the price of the underlying stock, per Chainlink's explainer. Other venues have pursued the same segment: Kraken offers tokenized stocks and ETFs through its xStocks product, and Robinhood Chain tracks tokenized equities on-chain.
updates.market_impact_zh: 若该功能形成规模，股票敞口将通过币安的交易与托管通道转化为链上代币，使 RWA 代币板块以及交易所对证券类挂钩产品的处理方式进入关注范围。其传导渠道主要在于托管安排与代币化股票的监管定性，而非特定代币的供应量变化。
updates.market_impact_en: If the feature operates at scale, equity exposure would flow into on-chain tokens through Binance's trading and custody rails, putting the RWA token segment and the exchange's handling of securities-linked products in scope. The transmission channel runs through custody arrangements and the regulatory treatment of tokenized equities rather than through any specific token supply change.

updates.title_zh: 【币安上线 JPMB、LLYB、SECZB 和 USDEB bStocks 交易对】
updates.title_en: 【币安上线 JPMB、LLYB、SECZB 和 USDEB bStocks 交易对】
updates.what_changed_zh:
币安发布公告称，将于 10 月 7 日 20:00 上线四个 bStocks 代币化证券交易对：JPMB/USDT、LLYB/USDT、SECZB/USDT 和 USDEB/USDT。现货算法交易机器人与现货上市同时启用，智能持仓机器人将在上线后 24 小时内启用，上线后一小时内可免手续费兑换为 BTC、USDT 或其他支持代币，零挂单手续费活动持续至 11 月 1 日 07:59。

此次上线把四个代币化股票交易对纳入币安现货市场，并在上市同时启用交易机器人、提供免手续费兑换窗口，扩展了该交易所的代币化证券产品线。币安同时提示，bStocks 服务及其功能因司法辖区而异，部分市场的用户无法使用。

bStocks 为代币化证券，每份由托管于受监管托管机构的 1 股美国股票 1:1 支撑，可在币安现货市场 24 小时交易。现货算法机器人与交易对同步上线，智能持仓机器人在 24 小时内跟进；零挂单手续费适用于 11 月 1 日 07:59 之前。
updates.what_changed_en: Binance announced it will list bStocks tokenized-securities pairs JPMB/USDT, LLYB/USDT, SECZB/USDT and USDEB/USDT on October 7 at 20:00, enabling spot algo trading bots at launch, smart holding bots within 24 hours, free conversion to BTC/USDT or other supported tokens in the first hour, and zero maker fees until November 1.

updates.background_zh: 币安将 bStocks 描述为代币化证券，提供对美国股票的完整经济敞口，并可在适用法律允许的前提下于 Binance.com 兑换为股票，使用户可 24 小时交易、结算几乎即时，而非 T+1 结算窗口。此前币安也曾在 bStocks 交易对上线时同步开放现货算法机器人服务。
updates.background_en: Binance describes bStocks as tokenized securities that provide full economic exposure to US equities and can be converted to equities on Binance.com subject to applicable laws, letting users trade them 24/7 with near-instant settlement rather than T+1 windows. Binance has previously enabled spot algo bot services for bStocks pairs at launch.
updates.market_impact_zh: 这批交易对扩大了币安现货市场对代币化美国股票的敞口，新增以 USDT 报价的品种及机器人驱动的成交，与既有现货市场争夺同一订单簿流动性。零挂单手续费窗口与一小时内免费兑换为 BTC/USDT，可能在短期内使订单流在新 bStocks 交易对与币安主要加密交易对之间转移，但辖区分级限制决定了哪些用户可以使用这些产品。
updates.market_impact_en: The pairs broaden Binance spot exposure to tokenized US equities, adding new USDT-quoted instruments and bot-driven flow that compete for the same order-book liquidity as existing spot markets. The zero-maker-fee window and one-hour free conversion into BTC/USDT can shift short-term order flow between the new bStocks pairs and major crypto pairs on Binance, though jurisdictional restrictions limit who can access the products.
